## INT8 KV-cache quantization benefit

INT8 KV cache reduces memory bandwidth for the full-attention layers.
The benefit grows with context length as KV reads dominate.

### 0.8B FP32w

| ctx | FP32 KV (tok/s) | INT8 KV (tok/s) | Speedup |
|----:|----------------:|----------------:|--------:|
 | 1 | 8.29 | 8.14 | 0.98× |
 | 64 | 8.25 | 8.08 | 0.98× |
 | 256 | 7.92 | 7.97 | 1.01× |
 | 1024 | 6.88 | 7.56 | 1.10× |
 | 4096 | 4.49 | 6.23 | 1.39× |

## Key findings

1. **GDN layers are O(1)**: per-layer cost is flat within ±2% across all context lengths.
2. **Full-attention is O(n)**: cost grows 9–13× from ctx=1 to ctx=4096.
3. **INT8 KV-cache benefit grows with context**: speedup increases as KV reads dominate the full-attention decode cost.
4. **INT8 weight quantization**: provides flat speedup across all context lengths (constant parts accelerate; O(n) parts don't).
5. **At 4K context**: full-attention consumes 40–58% of decode time in the hybrid model.
